summary: Kamada Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a US current report) announcing only that CEO Amir London will present at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference on September 15, 2026, at 2:30 p.m. ET, with one-on-one investor meetings available. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. The filing also notes FIMI Opportunity Funds as controlling shareholder with roughly 38% beneficial ownership. This is a routine investor-conference notice, not a special situation; the only watch item is any incremental commentary on M&A or plasma-collection strategy.
